content: Atɔŋ, un'lään awà u mpem amɛ anà ngyamàkà amɛ akà Nzam ntɔn ba, yà naa ba bàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ntɔn, mɛ in'wà mbäl, ba bye anà uyɔl akà Nzam, wɛɛ kà uyɔl abàkapaa pɛɛlà anki u ngyööb.
Mudiimà balàbal làfàfà akà Nzam anà muleŋ musà là ba ŋakwo, ba bàfàkal anki ungyɛl a balàbal a Nzam.
Ntɔn ntsüü a un'kɔɔn yà Klistɔ, ntɔn bàpɛ balàbal akà mbuur wanswà awe anà làkwikilà.
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ wà ntɔn mbuur wanswà kan'kyey Mwol
Nde ŋakwo Mɔsɛ kàsön ntɔn balàbal lan'fà akà un'kɔɔn naa: « Mbuur asàkwey nswɛɛŋ ayi, asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a ya. »
Wɛɛ, balàbal làfàfà unsà làkwikilà làtɛn abà: « Twon an'tɛn u mpem angye naa: "Nà asàbeenà du?" » Apɛy yà mutyeey Klistɔ.
Itàkal naa: « Nà asàtyà kà un'baan? Nkye apɛy yà mumbaar Klistɔ uboo a akü? »
Wɛɛ wa atɛɛnà aben? « Tsütsü apà ngye, yà ndaa, u mun anà u mpem angye. » Ndaa ayi, yà ndaa a làkwikilà alà ipay bi làsaŋ.
Isàkal naa u mun angye, ngye afàtà imbäl naa Yɛsu wà Mwol, isàkal naa u mpem angye, ngye awe anà làkwikilà naa Nzam kun'wiiy kà ukwà, ngye asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyakin, làkwikilà làfàbuul baar balàbal làfàfà u mpem, anà imbäl aki ifàwiiy baar mɔ̈ɔ̈ ifàtoo u mun.
Ntɔn, Ndaa Aŋàsɔn itɛɛnà naa: « Mbuur usàsà làkwikilà amu Nde, bàsun'mɛɛy anki nswɛn. »
Abun, nsöön yatɛy uboo Ayudà anà Angɛlɛki: ba banswà bà Mwol mwɛy, awà afàpà indiir ande akà baar banswà bàfun'bel.
Abun, mbuur asàbel ikɔb a Mwol akyer asàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Wɛɛ, ba bàyun'bel aben isàkal naa làkwikilà amu nde latɛy? Ba làkwikilà bàyàsà aben amu nde, isàkal naa ba bàŋàtun'wem anki? Ba bàyun'wem aben isàkal naa mbuur ŋàtalɔŋ anki?
Wɛɛ ba bàyàlɔŋ aben, isàkal naa ba batöm anki? Yumwɛy bàsön ayi: « Myà ubwaŋ in'kɔl a baar abà bàfàpay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ! »
Wɛɛ ba banswà bàkyey anki Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ alà.
Abun, làkwikilà làfàyà unsà ndaa bàfàwem, ngweem ifàfà u mbwo a Ndaa a Klistɔ.
Apan, mɛ in'fuul naa: Nkye ba bàwem anki? Ɛɛ, bàkyàwem! Ntɔn, bàsön naa:

content.text: « Làböl aba làpää u mɛɛn manswà,
ndaa aba yàtöl tii u ntsüü a mɛɛn. »

content: Abun, mɛ in'fuul naa: Aben, baar a Isàlɛl bàyöb anki? Utàtwɛb Mɔsɛ kàtɛn naa:

content.text: « Mɛ in'yàsɛɛn un'kɔ̈l abɛ akà undiir mpa awà un'sɛŋ,
mɛ in'yàmbaar nkyɛl abɛ akà un'sɛŋ akɔ̈ɔ̈n un'yɛnà. »

content: Yɛsay kan'kyà kwɛl mutɛn naa:

content.text: « Mɛ bàmàkan'man akà baar mpa bàyan'leŋà,
mɛ kàkàmɛɛy akà baar mpa ban'lɔ̈ɔ̈mà akà undiir mwɛy. »

content: Wɛɛ ntɔn Isàlɛl, Nde kàtɛn naa:

content.text: akà un'sɛŋ aŋunkwem anà wàŋun'tswe ngwal. »
